statements.status_notes: underscore is bundled inside nbclassic's static client-side assets at /opt/conda/lib/python3.13/site-packages/nbclassic/static/components/underscore/. nbclassic is a compatibility shim for the legacy Jupyter Notebook UI served under /tree; the default user-facing UI shipped by this image is JupyterLab 4.x (served under /lab) which does not load this bundled underscore. The vulnerable code runs in the user's browser only if they actively navigate to the classic UI, and only with input the user themselves controls (their own notebook content). No server-side code path imports or executes this bundled JavaScript.
